My Stats and background music arrive in Claimball

The latest test build adds a My Stats screen with your wins, draws and losses, and three original music tracks with an on/off toggle.

In short: Build 15 of Claimball, a TestFlight internal test build, adds a My Stats screen with your wins, draws and losses, plus three original music tracks you can turn on or off in Settings. It is not released to the public yet.

Build 15, a TestFlight internal test build, adds two things you can see and hear. It is not released to the public yet.

My Stats

The new My Stats screen shows your wins, draws and losses, your record against each opponent, and your longest rally. These records are kept only on your device.

Background music

Claimball now has three original tracks: one for the menu, one for matches, and a faster fever tempo. You can turn the music on or off with a toggle in Settings.

What is next

Claimball is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android. There is no release date yet.

FAQ

What does the My Stats screen show in Claimball?

It shows your wins, draws and losses, your record against each opponent, and your longest rally.

Where are my records stored?

These records are kept only on your device.

How many music tracks does Claimball have, and can I turn them off?

Claimball has three original tracks: one for the menu, one for matches, and a faster fever tempo. You can turn the music on or off with a toggle in Settings.

About the game: Claimball is a casual duel game on a notebook grid for iOS and Android (coming soon, not yet released).
